Putting Our Belief in People into Action

What our coaches choose to do with their skills says something important about who we are as a community.

In February 2025, 26 CMA coaches came together in Cambodia to support 120 young leaders through the I Am NOT Afraid Camp. They brought their professional experience and a shared conviction that young people deserve opportunities to discover their strengths, recognise their potential and take greater ownership of their lives.

Through personal leadership workshops, practical learning sessions, creative activities and group coaching, participants explored who they were becoming and what they wanted for their future. They examined how they responded to challenges, recognised strengths they could draw upon and began developing personal blueprints for the lives they wished to create.

At the heart of this experience was a belief central to CMA's approach to transformational coaching: meaningful change must belong to the person experiencing it.

Confidence cannot simply be given to someone. It develops as people recognise their own capabilities, discover new possibilities and begin to trust their capacity to make choices.

Throughout the camp, we witnessed moments of courage, growing self-belief and young people beginning to see themselves and their futures differently. These experiences reminded us of the significance a meaningful conversation can have, particularly when someone feels genuinely heard, understood and encouraged to explore what might be possible.

The coaches found themselves equally enriched by the experience.

They came to contribute their time, knowledge and experience. Yet the young people's stories, courage and aspirations offered fresh perspectives and renewed their own sense of purpose. The experience became one of learning and growth in both directions.

This is the kind of community we are committed to building at CMA.

People who continually deepen their professional mastery and willingly use their capabilities to contribute to the lives of others.

The Cambodia initiative reflects what becomes possible when a community of coaches acts together on what it believes.

I Am NOT Afraid Camp 2025, Cambodia

For CMA, helping people change better is a commitment we carry beyond our training programmes and into the world.
